title: Callback performs heavy side effects
summary: ActiveRecord callbacks perform network calls, file work, or expensive computation during save/update flows.
rationale: Callbacks can hide work in critical paths and amplify transaction time or retry impact.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Move side effects to explicit services or background jobs with idempotency and failure handling.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
